title: AI-Driven Discovery of Temporal-Demographic Interactions in Emergency Department Care Delivery: A Multi-Agent Collaborative Analysis of Healthcare Equity Patterns

contributions.purpose: 演示多智能体框架端到端自主开展科研
contributions.mechanism: 8 个 AI 模型(GPT-5/Claude/Gemini/Grok)跨 4 阶段 58 次交互协作:假设生成→设计综合→流水线→分析解释,对抗式评审
contributions.evaluation: 分析 91,359 例急诊就诊(初始 100,000,8.6% 衰减);checklist 假设/设计/分析=D(AI-generated)
contributions.domain: AI 自主科研 / 医疗公平
contributions.source_quote: We employed a novel multi-agent collaborative framework utilizing eight distinct AI models across 58 meticulously documented interactions, analyzing 91,359 patient encounters from four emergency department sites.

contributions.purpose: 揭示急诊就诊的种族差异及'保护性拥挤'悖论
contributions.mechanism: Gamma GLM(LOS)+ 线性/Cox(door-to-provider)+ census×种族交互 + 边际效应
contributions.evaluation: 基线:Hispanic/Latino DTP +10.9min、Other/Unknown +13.0min(p<0.001);声称高 census 时 LOS 差距缩小(H/L -6.8min)——但与模型系数矛盾(见 notes)
contributions.source_quote: our models detected a protective effect during high-census periods, where disparities decreased rather than increased, challenging conventional hypotheses about crowding-induced inequities.

notes: 重度数据/质量红旗。(1) 模型崩坏当发现报告:Table 2 的 Gamma GLM LOS 系数为 7.115e8、-1.552e10 全标 (unstable),R²=0.000/pseudo R²=0.0003,即模型数值发散、无解释力,却据此讲'保护性拥挤'故事。(2) 自相矛盾:正文 §3.3/摘要称保护效应 H/L 最强(LOS -6.8min),但 §3.4 与 Table 2 显示 Hispanic×Census 交互为正(差距反增)、仅 Other/Unknown 为负,叙事与系数打架。(3) 占位/破坏:Table 4 White 预测 LOS=0.0 标 'Model artifact - actual values non-zero but used as reference'。(4) 幻影/重复章节:2.2 与 2.3 同名 'Data Source and Population' 重复,3.4 重复,Figure 5 一处称 forest plot 一处称 tail metrics,图号混乱。(5) 数字不自洽:cohort 91,359 但模型 N=67,571;Table 3 White n=37,640 vs Figure 1 的 37,420;性别小计与总数对不上。(6) SHAP 分析在讨论中被引用但正文无对应图。真实私有数据宣称不可共享(checklist Q5 data=No)。与 reject 一致。
